note: TWO THINGS TO KNOW BEFORE TRUSTING THIS TAB. (1) The RBA publishes only an UNATTRIBUTED vote count -- 'the Board decided by six votes to three'. No member is ever named, so unlike the FOMC version of this tool, a roster here can never be scored against a published tally. It encodes your read of the Board, and that read is doing all the work. (2) Every score below is a neutral 2.5 placeholder and every seat past the first two is unfilled, deliberately: this app does not assert policy views for real people it has not sourced. Fill the names from rba.gov.au/about-rba/boards/monetary-policy-board/ and set the scores from each member's own speeches, then flip verified to true. 5 = most hawkish.
